methodologyNote: Measured via page views of macOS desktop traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, macOS Catalina led macos versions (desktop) in Asia at 71.6% (market share of tracked page views / usage). macOS 19 ranked second at 11.86%, followed by macOS 15.7 at 2.15%.

faqs.question: Which item leads macos versions (desktop) in Asia?
faqs.answer: macOS Catalina leads at 71.6% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/macos-version-market-share/desktop/asia.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for macos versions (desktop) in Asia?
faqs.answer: macOS Catalina (71.6%), macOS 19 (11.86%), macOS 15.7 (2.15%) in October 2026.
